stories.headline: Dream Labs launches Dream-1 robot model
stories.summary: Dream Labs unveiled Dream-1, a world action model for unseen robots, and said it is also exiting stealth with $90M in seed funding.
stories.why_it_matters: A fresh robotics model plus major seed funding signals serious momentum.

stories.headline: UK announces broader AI investment plan
stories.summary: The UK Chancellor announced hundreds of millions in AI-related investment, including a new AI Cyber Security Centre of Excellence.
stories.why_it_matters: Policy and infrastructure spending can shape national AI adoption fast.
